task_specification.objective: Deliver three bounded survivor-core repairs: a stateful first-run and retry flow with an authored visual upgrade-choice hierarchy, a readable/clamped camera with repeatable Dash and collision-aware spatial routing, and a complete ordinary five-wave run with Bellkeeper Result/Replay. Preserve the authored cemetery package, icon-led upgrade foundations, Dash/pause ownership invariants, and native Godot boot baselines.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate lacks three closure-ready player-facing surfaces: onboarding guidance is static and unverified through completion/retry, camera and spatial framing leave ordinary enemies too small while traversal and obstacle recovery are unproven, and the ordinary five-wave/Bellkeeper completion route is not implemented or evidenced.

stop_conditions: Do not expand beyond the three exact required gaps or mix upgrade-visual redesign or dense-profile telemetry into the camera/spatial task.
Stop if a change would replace or destructively modify the preserved authored cemetery package or native Godot project baseline.

Tester/Runtime must provide fresh black-box and visual evidence for ordinary route completion, guidance completion/retry persistence, camera/Dash/obstacle behavior, and choice focus/value hierarchy before any gap is considered closed.

strategy.rationale: Use materially different root-cause treatments: bind onboarding to authoritative lifecycle state and repair the upgrade visual hierarchy, rebase camera/player/enemy navigation around explicit zoom and collision contracts, and complete the ordinary wave director, Result, and Replay state machine. Keep each family isolated so evidence can retest the exact host-gated behavior.

code: Run bounded Godot/static checks for lifecycle, UI draft, camera/player/enemy-spatial, and wave/result owners; confirm native_godot_project and host_godot_boot remain passing.
Verify each task's target paths stay candidate-relative and no diagnostic-only shortcut is exposed in release input maps.
runtime: Tester/Runtime recapture: guidance milestone sequence, completion persistence, Retry and title return; live upgrade draft hierarchy/value truth and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus; camera zoom bounds/modal isolation, Dash across lifecycle events, ordinary movement/cardinal views, obstacle collisions and blocked-route recovery; and a normal five-wave Bellkeeper success through Result and Replay.
Require fresh JSONL/state receipts tied to each exact required gap and black-box replay; distinguish ordinary success from failure/diagnostic branches.
visual: Capture shipped 1280x720 views during ordinary movement and dense occupancy to confirm enemy readability, stable cemetery composition, central landmark/perimeter visibility, and absence of disappearance or occlusion drift.

Inspect onboarding, pause/upgrade/Result/title modal focus states and the ordinary-success Result for clear state transitions and no stale overlays; inspect silhouettes/icons and current-to-new values at native resolution.

done_when: Guidance is state-bound to first-run milestones (movement, Dash, automatic attack, pickup/upgrade) and visibly advances or dismisses only when each input is performed; completion persists through Retry and title return without reappearing incorrectly.

Retry restores a fresh authoritative run while preserving the intended guidance-completion flag; pause/modal input isolation prevents gameplay input from accidentally advancing or dismissing guidance.

Upgrade/weapon choices use a concrete choice hierarchy or visual hierarchy: each option leads with authored silhouettes or icons, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values, no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed states; no NEW or LOCKED placeholder appears in a CURRENT value column.

Tester can black-box verify guidance start, each milestone transition, completion, Retry, and title-return/re-entry, then inspect a live draft and selected-build state for hierarchy, values, and all three focus modalities.
tasks.instructions: Repair the onboarding and run-lifecycle controller so guidance is a stateful sequence driven by authoritative player actions, not a static panel or timer. Persist a completion marker in the supported profile/session boundary, reset gameplay state cleanly on Retry, and restore title/start semantics without stale overlays or duplicated listeners. Render live InputMap bindings and keep guidance contextual, concise, dismissible, and backed by the shipped arena illustration. In the real upgrade-draft scene/controller, implement the required choice hierarchy/visual hierarchy: authored weapon or upgrade silhouettes/icons, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states; never use NEW or LOCKED as a CURRENT value placeholder. Keep Dash reset and pause ownership invariants intact. Add focused assertions or debug-visible state needed for Tester black-box verification, but do not substitute instrumentation for the actual transitions.
tasks.title: Stateful onboarding, Retry, and choice hierarchy

done_when: Ordinary enemies occupy a readable, legible screen scale relative to the player in the shipped 1280x720 framing during ordinary movement and dense occupancy.
Mouse-wheel and gamepad zoom expose explicit minimum/default/maximum bounds, clamp at all bounds, and are isolated while guidance, pause, upgrade, Result, or title modals own input focus.
Dash is repeatable after cooldown and remains correct across pause, damage, death, Retry, and title return; no stale cooldown or lockout survives lifecycle reset.

Enemy navigation uses collision-aware blocked-route recovery so ordinary enemies cannot enter coffins, graves/gravestones, walls, or buildings; blocked routes recover without tunneling, pass-through, disappearance, or camera occlusion.

Arena scale is a larger traversable scale with a coherent external world/external depth; every central building/landmark and boundary/perimeter remains visible and aligned under ordinary movement/movement replay, with collision preventing pass-through and no disappearance or occlusion drift.
Tester can replay cardinal and obstacle-adjacent movement and verify camera bounds, occupancy, Dash lifecycle, collision, boundary, and blocked-route recovery in fresh runtime evidence.
tasks.instructions: Implement one focused camera/player/Warden and enemy/spatial repair. Calibrate readable ordinary-enemy scale in the 1280x720 camera, add explicit mouse-wheel and gamepad minimum/default/maximum zoom with clamping and modal input isolation, and make Dash cooldown/reset repeatable across pause, damage, death, Retry, and title. Rebase movement and enemy navigation onto the authored cemetery's larger traversable scale and external world/external depth: preserve the central building/landmark and perimeter/boundary with aligned collision, prevent pass-through or disappearance/occlusion during ordinary movement/movement replay, and add collision-aware blocked-route recovery around coffins, graves/gravestones, walls, and buildings.
